about: The record documents stage 3 chronic kidney disease and no statin supply during the year.
Possible finding: one eGFR result is below 60 and no statin is supplied. The record lacks confirmation of "Chronic kidney disease" or an earlier qualifying result.
No statin is supplied, but two eGFR results (88 and 85, seven months apart) show normal kidney function and there is no kidney disease line, so there is no finding.
